age_limit.age_details: 18-45 years (Research Officer); 18-35 years (Lab Technician, Field Worker)

qualification.details: Research Officer: 18-45 years Lab Technician: 18-35 years Field Worker: 18-35 years | Essential: MBBS/BDS/MPH with 02 years of research experience/Experience in working in Pediatrics Department or Child Health. | Desirable: At least one publication. | Essential (either one): | B.Sc. in Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Life Science with at least 01 year of work in a diagnostic/research laboratory, OR 12th with a diploma in medical laboratory Technology and at least 03 years of work in a diagnostic/research laboratory. | Desirable: Certificate in computer application, for example PGDCA/DCA. | Essential: 10+2/equivalent from a recognized board and 3 years of experience working in a diagnostic laboratory. | Desirable: DMLT/DALT with one year of experience working in a diagnostic laboratory. | For the full eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

how_to_apply: Download the application form. It is printed at the end of the official notification.
Fill in the form in the given format. It must be typed and signed. Do not change the serial number order or the column headings. You may add extra details on separate annexure sheets.

The form asks for: advertisement number, post applied for, name and father's/husband's name in block letters, postal address, contact number, email in capital letters, date of birth with proof, category (UR/ST/SC/OBC), gender, educational qualifications, work experience, current job, publications (only PUBMED indexed journals, as an annexure) and how long you would need before joining.
Staple or pin two recent, self-signed, passport-size colour photographs to the first page of the form.
Attach self-attested photocopies of your certificates.
On the envelope write: "Application for the contractual post of ______ In BMGF multicentric iKMC study, AIIMS, Raipur, C.G." Fill in the name of the post.

Send it by speed post only to: Dr. Atul Jindal, Professor, Paediatrics, Room No. 1655, B-Block, Third Floor, New Administration Building, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Tatibandh, G.E Road, Raipur, Pin: 492099. It must arrive by 02:00 PM on 12 November 2026.
Applications delivered by hand, or incomplete applications, will be rejected. Tracking your application is your own responsibility, and the institute is not responsible for postal delays.
The completed application form in the prescribed format
Copies of research publications and experience certificates, if you have any
One set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raipur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raipur is located on G.E. Road, Tatibandh, Raipur – 492099, Chhattisgarh. These posts are part of the BMGF Multicentric iKMC Study run by the Department of Pediatrics. Dr. Atul Jindal, Professor, is the Principal Investigator (P.I) for the study.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A selection committee will check the applications. Candidates will be selected through an interview. A written test will also be held if there are more than 50 eligible candidates for a post. Selection is based purely on merit. The list of eligible candidates will be put up on the AIIMS Raipur website, along with the date, time and venue of the interview or written test. Candidates will not be contacted separately. The list of selected candidates will appear on the website, and the people chosen will be told by email. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The job is for a fixed 6 months. Depending on the candidate's performance, it can be extended by up to 2.5 more years. You will not be on the AIIMS, Raipur payroll. The job ends automatically when the project is completed. Neither AIIMS, Raipur nor the principal investigators have any obligation to give permanent employment, and candidates cannot claim a permanent job on the basis of this one. You will be asked which posting centre you prefer, and your choice will be considered. However, the Principal Investigator alone decides the final posting. Transfers to other units depend on what the project needs, not on what the candidate prefers.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for the AIIMS Raipur Lab Technician post with a DMLT instead of a B.Sc.?
faq.answer: Yes. You need 12th plus a diploma in medical laboratory Technology and at least 03 years of work in a diagnostic/research laboratory. A B.Sc. holder needs only 01 year of such work.

faq.question: Q2. Can I hand in my application at AIIMS Raipur in person?
faq.answer: No. Applications are accepted only by speed post. Any application delivered by hand will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Where will the Field Worker be posted?
faq.answer: The Field Worker will be based at DH Kondagaon. The job involves carrying samples every day from the peripheral centres to AIIMS, Raipur.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written test?
faq.answer: Only if there are more than 50 eligible candidates for a post. Otherwise, selection is through an interview alone.

faq.question: Q5. Will this job become permanent?
faq.answer: No. The job is not on the AIIMS, Raipur payroll and ends automatically when the project is over. It runs for 6 months to begin with and can be extended by up to 2.5 more years.

faq.question: Q6. Do I need a publication for the Research Officer post?
faq.answer: A publication is not essential. At least one publication is listed as desirable. In the application form, list only publications in PUBMED indexed journals, as an annexure.

faq.question: Q7. What do I write on the envelope?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the contractual post of ______ In BMGF multicentric iKMC study, AIIMS, Raipur, C.G.", filling in the post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q8. Will AIIMS Raipur pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who do I contact with questions?
faq.answer: Write to Dr. Atul Jindal, Professor & P.I, BMGF Multicentric iKMC Study, Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS Raipur, at [email protected].
